name: MORROW API
author: me@khayrul.com
description: MORROW proposal API. The image is ghcr.io/lavishsphere/morrow:latest. Nginx on the VPS proxies public HTTPS to this server's allocation. Leave DATABASE_URL empty to keep the bundled dataset.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
echo "The API is already in the image at /app."

variables.name: Tiger database URL
variables.description: Tiger Cloud Postgres URL with sslmode=require. Leave empty for the bundled Wellesley dataset. Never commit this value.

variables.name: Gemini API key
variables.description: Optional. When empty, proposals use the template and health reports Gemini unavailable.

variables.name: Gemini model
variables.description: Model id used only when GEMINI_API_KEY is set.

variables.name: OpenRouter API key
variables.description: Optional. When Gemini is slow or busy, proposals are drafted with Gemini through OpenRouter. Leave empty to turn this off.

variables.name: OpenRouter models
variables.description: Optional comma-separated list. Empty uses google/gemini-3.8-flash, google/gemini-3.6-flash, google/gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

variables.name: Pages origin
variables.description: Browser origins allowed to call the API, separated by commas, e.g. https://plsfixthisshit.work,https://morrow.khayrul.com. Empty allows any origin.
